coordinateFrame: Runtime metres; stage dais at origin; -Z upstage (default-camera backdrop), +Z downstage (camera side)

heroPresentations.principle: Every hero asset is staged individually — clear sightline, breathing room, a deliberate viewing angle from the default camera. Heroes are never scatter-filler.

arch-colonnade.staging: The three arches read as one family: sunlit_coral_arch is the upstage proscenium framing the stage; the other two chain off it as a receding swim-through colonnade curving toward the kelp curtain, portals aligned so visitor fish schools stream through them.

reef-wall.staging: The wide reef presents BROADSIDE to the default camera as the eastern backdrop shoulder of coral-garden-east — never edge-on, never half-hidden behind another hero.

basalt-canyon.staging: Pinnacles form a slot canyon, not a fence: two staggered parallel ridge lines with a 3-4 m navigable gap between them, tallest pinnacles at the upstage end. A fish cluster anchor sits in the gap so schools thread the canyon.

coral-skyline.staging: Stepped silhouette trio behind the proscenium: citadel tallest and center-left, mountain mid-height right, tower as the near accent. Three distinct heights against the fog — never two at the same apparent height from the default camera.

specimen-corals.staging: Museum-specimen rule inside coral-garden-east: each specimen gets its own clear pad with nothing taller within 1.5 m, oriented to its best face. Fan coral presents broadside; table coral gets a low neighbor cluster under its overhang; bommie anchors the garden's downstage corner.

wreck.staging: Half-buried, listing ~20 degrees, bow toward the stage so the sightline from the default camera runs stage-to-wreck. Octopus posed in the hull shadow.

rock-tables.staging: Structural supporting cast: rock_table as a mid-ground perch (fish anchor), the rest as stepping-stone cluster cores — grouped in odd numbers, partially buried, never floating.

zones.notes: Arch relocated upstage-center and scaled to frame the stage from the default camera. Flanked by citadel and mid corals.
Densest, most colorful zone. Reef-fish cluster anchor.
